name: Fusion Micro Finance Limited
summary: Fusion Micro Finance Limited provides microfinance in India as a non-banking financial institution, mainly to women entrepreneurs in rural and semi-urban areas. Its products include business loans, both unsecured and secured, machinery financing and small collateral-free credit. Gurugram is its base, and it dates from 1994. It was formerly Fusion Microfinance Private Limited, renamed in July 2021.
